title: Balanced Cuts of Conference Matrices: Squared-Spectrum Rigidity and Hermitian Holonomy
description: This preprint studies the normalized cross-block Gram spectra of balanced cuts in symmetric and Hermitian conference matrices. It proves that cut independence occurs exactly through half-size three, making order six the unique nontrivial symmetric conference case. At order six, balanced sign controls are the exact degree-three Schur-sector maximizers; squared real triangle holonomy parametrizes the complete Hermitian Pareto frontier, characterizes the real switching class through cutwise sector constancy, and yields quantitative stability. A general orientation theorem and a six-mode conference-interferometer design limit are applications of this matrix structure.
